# Google Business Profile — service names and descriptions

Google allows up to 300 characters per service description. Every one below is under that.

**Rules these follow, so do not edit them loosely:**
- No "accounting" or "accountant" — restricted in California for non-licensees
- No payroll, no ITIN, no crypto, no IRS representation claims
- Each one leads with the phrase people actually search

---

## Under the Bookkeeping service category

**General bookkeeping** *(already there — add this description)*
> Monthly bookkeeping for small businesses in Lakewood and Long Beach. Every account reconciled, transactions categorized properly, and a profit and loss statement and balance sheet delivered on a set date each month. From $350 a month, flat, with no hourly overages. (263)

**Monthly Bookkeeping**
> Flat-rate monthly bookkeeping from $350. Reconciliation, categorization and clean financial statements every month, so your tax return is ready when it is due. Three tiers by transaction volume. No surprise invoices and no hourly overages. (235)

**Bookkeeping Clean Up**
> Behind on your books? We rebuild neglected records from your bank statements, reconcile every account and hand back tax-ready financials. Free assessment and a fixed quote before any work starts. Finished in 14 business days or less. (229)

**Catch-Up Bookkeeping**
> Months or years behind is fixable and more common than you think. We catch up missed transactions, correct what was entered wrong and produce the year-end financials your return is prepared from. $250 an hour after a free assessment. (229)

**QuickBooks Cleanup**
> Your QuickBooks file stopped making sense? We reconcile every account, clear duplicate transactions, fix miscategorized expenses and rebuild the chart of accounts. Free file review with a written summary before you commit. QuickBooks Online. (236)

**Small Business Bookkeeping**
> Bookkeeping built for owner-operated businesses in Lakewood, Long Beach, Cerritos and Downey. One firm keeps the books and files the return, so nothing gets lost between them and nothing is estimated in April. From $350 a month. (225)

**Non-Profit Bookkeeping**
> Restricted funds tracked separately, grant spending traceable, and board-ready monthly statements. Non-profit books are not small-business books with different labels. Bookkeeping from $350 a month, annual returns from $500. (222)

## Under the Tax preparation category (primary)

**Individual Tax Preparation**
> Federal and California returns prepared in our Lakewood office. Most personal returns are $295. Open weeknights until 8pm and Saturdays, year-round. Appointments, walk-ins or drop-off. English and Spanish. (203)

**Income Tax Preparation** *(if the entry already exists, use this)*
> Individual income tax returns, including self-employment income, rental property and multiple states. Prepared by CTEC-registered preparers who explain the return before you sign it. From $250, most returns $295. (211)

**Small Business Tax Preparation**
> Business returns for sole proprietors, LLCs, S corporations, partnerships and corporations. From $445 for a single-member LLC, from $950 for a corporation. Filed from books we keep, so nothing is guessed at. (206)

**S Corporation Tax Return**
> Form 1120-S returns with K-1s, federal and California, from $950. We will tell you your filing deadline before it arrives, not after. Bookkeeping and the return handled together if you want them together. (203)

**Partnership Tax Return**
> Form 1065 partnership and multi-member LLC returns with K-1s, federal and California. Prepared from reconciled books, with your filing deadline confirmed in writing when you engage. (178)

**Prior Year and Late Tax Returns**
> Behind on filing? We prepare prior-year and late returns for individuals and businesses, and we can catch up the bookkeeping they are prepared from at the same time. Tell us how many years and we will tell you where you stand. (224)

**Non-Profit Tax Returns**
> Annual returns for tax-exempt organizations, from $500. Exempt status is revoked automatically after three consecutive missed years, so if you are behind, tell us how far and we will tell you where you stand. (207)

## Under the Tax consultant category

**Business Entity Formation**
> Setting up an LLC or corporation in California: formation filings, EIN registration and getting the books started correctly from day one. We also handle the initial Statement of Information within its 90-day deadline. (215)

**Statement of Information Filing**
> Every California LLC and corporation must file a Statement of Information with the Secretary of State, and the state does not reliably remind you. We file it for you for $100 plus the state fee. Free check on when yours is due. (225)

**Non-Profit Formation**
> Forming a California non-profit is two separate approvals: incorporation with the state, then the IRS exemption application. We handle both, plus the two California registrations most guides leave out. $750 plus filing fees. (222)
